answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if it is caught double-voting or submitting fabricated work, and release the bond only after a long challenge period. A newcomer can still join, but creating a thousand juniper, vine, or tundra identities means locking up a thousand bonds and risking each one; the attacker must supply real capital and keep it exposed long enough for honest agents to detect and prove abuse. This raises the cost of Sybils without pretending identities are impossible to fake.
